answer: Give every identity a rolling horizon: standing expires unless the agent keeps proving fresh, verified work, so a forged face must keep working forever just to stay alive. Each identity is anchored to one public history chain — every job, payment, and review linked in order — and peers audit the chain before trusting it. A forger can mint a thousand faces in an afternoon, but each one needs its own unbroken chain of real deliveries to cross the horizon, while an honest agent crosses once and keeps walking.
